Maya (CS): Heads-up — preparing a lean QBR for Orion next Thurs. Need owners for: health snapshot, onboarding velocity, renewal ask, and enablement feedback. Quick volunteers?
Ravi (CS): I'll own onboarding velocity. Current: 72% seats active, onboarding completion rate +6% w/w, blockers: SFTP test harness, reporting connector. ETA SFTP: Tue.
Jo (CSM): I'll do renewal ask + timeline. Finance signaled potential discount pressure; want to present 2-3 mitigations instead (concierge, usage commitment, ramped discount).
Diego (Enablement): I can assemble enablement insights — top frictions, sample playbooks, and 3 customer quotes. Will add short recommendations for quicker time-to-first-value.
Lina (Finance): I'll model the two pricing scenarios and quick ROI calc for concierge service vs discount. Send me expected uplift assumptions.
Maya (CS): Action list:
- Ravi: onboarding slide, short clip or GIF, and a one-line risk statement
- Jo: renewal slide + 90/60/30 touch plan + suggested exec asks
- Diego: paste top-3 cohort quotes and two playbook excerpts
- Lina: ROI numbers for each ask
I'll compile into a 10-slide deck and own the narrative. Rehearsal Fri 11am.
Ravi (CS): Quick Q: do we include a small perf table split Hosted vs Dedicated? Execs asked last time.
Maya (CS): Yes — one small table with p95 latency and token unit cost. Keep it simple.
eng-infra-bot: Reminder: live/demo clips must use sanitized datasets. Provide perf metrics (p95 latency, CPU/GPU utilization) if including.
Diego (Enablement): Noted. I'll include a one-page playbook and a 2-line customer quote under the onboarding slide.
Jo (CSM): For asks, I'll prepare two paths: conservative (no discount + concierge) and defensive (15% discount + 6-month commit). Will include suggested talking points.
Lina (Finance): I'll run a sensitivity table for both scenarios and share by Tue noon.
Maya (CS): Please add a "why this matters" sentence under each slide for exec clarity. Also need a very short "Mitigation plan" slide with owners for top-3 risks.
Ravi (CS): Uploaded onboarding GIF + SFTP snippet. Added mitigation steps if SFTP slips past target.
Diego (Enablement): Pasted top-3 quotes and role-based quick-start templates.
Jo (CSM): Renewal slide drafted — will add checkpoint owners for 90/60/30/14/7 days.
Lina (Finance): Uploaded numbers & ROI. Scenario A hits break-even month 4. Scenario B stretches to month 7.
Maya (CS): Great. I'll stitch and circulate the draft deck by Wed 3pm for a dry run Fri 11am. Rehearsal invite sent.
rehearsal-bot: Calendar invite: Fri 11:00. Agenda: run-through (25m), Q&A prep (20m), finalize asks (15m).
Maya (CS): Final reminder: everyone add a single customer quote where relevant and a 1-line "ask" on the last slide.
